name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: An inline, always-open date field component that allows users to select a date.
usageSnippet:
<let/selectedDates=[] as { year: number; month: number; day: number }[]/>
<Calendar value:=selectedDates/>

props.name: captionLayout
props.description:
Caption presentation. `"label"` (default) shows the visible range as a
plain view-trigger button; `"dropdown"` swaps it for native month and year
`<select>` controls. Component-owned — not forwarded to the machine.

props.name: createCalendar
props.description:
A function that creates a Calendar object for a given calendar identifier.
Enables non-Gregorian calendar support (Persian, Buddhist, Islamic, etc.)
without bundling all calendars by default.

props.name: defaultFocusedValue
props.description:
Initial visible-month focus, as a plain (optionally non-Gregorian)
date. Pins the SSR-rendered month instead of falling back to the
browser's wall-clock "today" (`getTodayDate`), which would otherwise
make SSR and hydrated markup diverge near midnight or across
timezones.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the date picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the date picker.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected date(s) when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected date(s) of the date picker.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The default view of the calendar

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the calendar is disabled.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description:
Whether the calendar should have a fixed number of weeks.
This renders the calendar with 6 weeks instead of 5 or 6.

props.name: focusedValue
props.description: Controlled visible-month focus, as a plain (optionally non-Gregorian) date.

props.name: format
props.description: The format of the date to display in the input.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the date picker. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the date picker is invalid

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Returns whether a date of the calendar is available.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale (BCP 47 language tag) to use when formatting the date.

props.name: max
props.type: { year: number; month: number; day: number; }
props.description: Latest selectable date (inclusive); days after it render disabled.

props.name: maxSelectedDates
props.description:
The maximum number of dates that can be selected.
This is only applicable when `selectionMode` is `multiple`.

props.name: maxView
props.description: The maximum view of the calendar

props.name: min
props.type: { year: number; month: number; day: number; }
props.description: Earliest selectable date (inclusive); days before it render disabled.

props.name: minView
props.description: The minimum view of the calendar

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the input element.

props.name: numOfMonths
props.description: The number of months to display.

props.name: openOnClick
props.description: Whether to open the calendar when the input is clicked.

props.name: outsideDaySelectable
props.description: Whether day outside the visible range can be selected.

props.name: parse
props.type: ((value: string, details: LocaleDetails) => DateValue | undefined) | undefined
props.description: Function to parse the date from the input back to a DateValue.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text to display in the input.

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the date picker content

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the calendar is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the date picker is required

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
The selection mode of the calendar.
- `single` - only one date can be selected
- `multiple` - multiple dates can be selected
- `range` - a range of dates can be selected

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: Whether to show the week number column in the day view.

props.name: startOfWeek
props.description:
The first day of the week.
 `0` - Sunday
 `1` - Monday
 `2` - Tuesday
 `3` - Wednesday
 `4` - Thursday
 `5` - Friday
 `6` - Saturday

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The time zone to use

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.

props.name: value
props.type: { year: number; month: number; day: number; }[]
props.description: Selected date(s) as plain objects — one entry per selected date (single mode uses a one-element array).

props.name: view
props.description: The view of the calendar

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: Function called when the focused date changes.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the calendar opens or closes.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function called when the value changes.

events.name: onViewChange
events.description: Function called when the view changes.

events.name: onVisibleRangeChange
events.description: Function called when the visible range changes.

events.name: valueChange
events.arg: { year: number; month: number; day: number; }[]
events.description: Fires with the full selection as plain date objects whenever it changes; enables `value:=` two-way binding.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: An uncontrolled calendar with no date selected initially.

examples.title: Persian / Hijri / Jalali Calendar
examples.description: Pass `locale` and `createCalendar` (re-exported from `@internationalized/date`, the same helper upstream's own MDX points to) to switch the calendar system — no react-day-picker locale swap needed (upstream swaps in a persian build of the library and loads the Vazirmatn webfont for Arabic-script glyphs; here the font is your app's business). A controlled initial `value` is intentionally omitted here: `calendar.marko`'s `toDateValue()` always builds a Gregorian `CalendarDate`, so a hardcoded non-Gregorian `{ year, month, day }` would be silently misinterpreted.

examples.title: Range
examples.description: Set `selectionMode="range"` to select a start and end date.

examples.title: Month and Year Selector
examples.description: Set `captionLayout="dropdown"` to swap the caption label for native month and year `<select>` controls.

examples.title: Presets
examples.description: Preset buttons that jump the selection to a relative date. Our Calendar has no separate controlled visible-month prop (upstream's `month`/`onMonthChange`) — the Zag machine re-focuses its visible month whenever `value` changes, so presets still navigate the grid correctly.

examples.title: Date and Time Picker
examples.source:
import Calendar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/calendar/calendar.marko";
import Card from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/card.marko";
import CardContent from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/content.marko";
import CardFooter from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/footer.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-group.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";
import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";

static const focusedValue = { year: 2026, month: 8, day: 15 };

<Card size="sm" class="mx-auto w-fit">
  <CardContent>
    <Calendar class="p-0" defaultFocusedValue=focusedValue/>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter class="border-t bg-card">
    <FieldGroup>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel for="calendar-time-from">Start Time</FieldLabel>
        <InputGroup>
          <InputGroupInput
            id="calendar-time-from"
            type="time"
            step="1"
            value="10:30:00"
            class="appearance-none [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:hidden [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:appearance-none"
          />
          <InputGroupAddon>
            <Icon name="Clock2Icon" class="text-muted-foreground"/>
          </InputGroupAddon>
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel for="calendar-time-to">End Time</FieldLabel>
        <InputGroup>
          <InputGroupInput
            id="calendar-time-to"
            type="time"
            step="1"
            value="12:30:00"
            class="appearance-none [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:hidden [&::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator]:appearance-none"
          />
          <InputGroupAddon>
            <Icon name="Clock2Icon" class="text-muted-foreground"/>
          </InputGroupAddon>
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
    </FieldGroup>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
examples.description: A calendar paired with `Field`/`InputGroup` time inputs in a card footer.

examples.title: Booked dates
examples.description: Use `isDateUnavailable` to mark specific dates unselectable. Unlike upstream's strikethrough styling, our day button has no per-day custom-class hook, so booked days render as ordinary unselectable days rather than struck through.

examples.title: Custom Cell Size
examples.description: Customize cell size with the `--cell-size` CSS variable, responsively via breakpoint-specific arbitrary values. Upstream's per-day weekend/weekday price labels are omitted — our day button has no content-render slot to inject them.

examples.title: Dropdown caption
examples.description: The hero preview: `captionLayout="dropdown"` swaps the caption label for native month and year `<select>` controls.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Calendar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/calendar/calendar.marko";
{ value = next; } /> Selected: ${value[0] ? `${value[0].year}-${value[0].month}-${value[0].day}` : "none"}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.

examples.title: Multiple
examples.description: Set `selectionMode="multiple"` to allow selecting more than one date.

examples.title: Min / Max
examples.source:
import Calendar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/calendar/calendar.marko";

<Calendar min={ year: 2026, month: 8, day: 1 } max={ year: 2026, month: 8, day: 20 }/>
examples.description: Pass `min` and `max` as plain `{ year, month, day }` objects to restrict the selectable range.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled calendar ignores pointer input and is skipped by the tab order.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source: import Calendar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/calendar/calendar.marko"; static const focusedValue = { year: 2026, month: 8, day: 15 };
examples.description: Pass `dir="rtl"` and a BCP-47 `locale` string (the Zag machine's own locale shape, rather than upstream's `react-day-picker/locale` object) for right-to-left rendering.
